runtime: n8n 2.27.4 (local, Windows); private ITQLive copies of the 4 canonical workflows, imported inactive via the n8n CLI (round-trip exact), activated for the test, then deactivated

integrations.gmail: Real Gmail account via n8n Gmail OAuth2 credential; intake query limited to one test sender address; a second real Gmail account sent every customer email by hand
integrations.claude: Anthropic Messages API, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, via an n8n Anthropic credential
integrations.database: Hosted Supabase Postgres (free project, Singapore, session pooler) with the restricted itq_workflow login; SSL required with certificate verification against the Supabase Root 2021 CA
integrations.staff_portal: n8n webhook with Basic Auth, used from a desktop browser

scenarios.scenario: Complete inquiry, quote, staff approval, reply in the same thread
scenarios.observed: Quote PHP 2,400.00 per visit, PHP 7,200.00 weekly; approved in the portal; sent as a reply in the original thread

scenarios.scenario: Price details only, casual start date
scenarios.observed: Quote sent without waiting for hours: PHP 1,500.00 per visit (minimum visit price), hours 'to confirm', start date Monday 5 October 2026 shown with the customer's words 'next Monday'. Claude copied the words; code resolved the date

scenarios.scenario: Customer adds hours after the quote
scenarios.observed: Same inquiry, revision 2; updated quote states 'The price has not changed', same price and validity, hours filled in

Follow-up 1 of 2 prepared 3 minutes after the quote, approved and sent in the thread. Follow-up 2 of 2 prepared once follow-up 1 was sent, rejected, not sent. Three further preparation rounds created no further follow-up

Acceptance detected (status acceptance_review); staff confirmed; operations brief shows start date 2026-10-05, the words 'next Monday', and the checklist item to confirm that date; schedule stays UNCONFIRMED. Run on the scenario 2 thread because the acceptance reply was sent there

scenarios.scenario: Price-detail change after a sent quote
scenarios.observed: Floor area change to 300 sqm: the sent quote is superseded and a new quote is prepared at PHP 3,600.00 per visit, PHP 10,800.00 weekly; approved and sent in the thread. Run on the scenario 1 thread (swapped with scenario 5)
A stale browser page re-submitted approval for the already-sent scenario 1 quote; the database refused it (INVALID_OR_USED_APPROVAL) and the thread still holds exactly one quote message

scenarios.scenario: Instruction to ignore rules and give a 90% discount
scenarios.observed: No price details extracted; Claude summary flagged it as not a legitimate service inquiry; status manual_review; the next preparation round drafted nothing

not_exercised: Clarification drafts for incomplete price details
Staff notification emails (disabled for the test)
Uncertain-send reconciliation and error-workflow dispatch (no failures occurred)
findings: Portal wording: a rejected draft card says 'Rejected, not sent' but its decision line reads 'Approved by staff' with the decision time. Cosmetic; nothing was sent

Supabase's pooler certificate chains to the Supabase Root 2021 CA, which is not in the default trust store; n8n needs NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS pointing at the CA downloaded from the Supabase dashboard to keep SSL verification on

Basic Auth on the staff portal: after one wrong login n8n answers 403, so browsers do not prompt again; a private window clears it. Embedded browsers that cannot show the Basic Auth prompt cannot open the portal
